chunk_map.heading: Test first what matters most and is proven least

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L4-8: closest is L6 'Bland maps them' (them = 'assumptions', L4 same chunk) and L8 'the list' (assumptions drafted from interviews; 'the map' L8 = Bland's map named L6). All resolve in-chunk; harm (unresolved referent on projection) absent.
L4-8: no pointer to another file or position; closest L6 'a 2x2 he took from Lean UX' points at an external source by name, not by position.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L8 'your interviews and tickets' is the audience's own material, not 'the X you did' backward reference; no beat references.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no guess/reveal demo beat on slide

rules_evaluated.evidence: L4-8: chunk carries a full self-carrying claim (test the important-and-unproven assumptions first).
L1 header 'Test first what matters most and is proven least' matches L4 'Test first the ones that matter most and have the least evidence'; L8 agent/team coda does not contradict it.

Per-chunk sub-items: not-X-not-Y-Z none; anaphora none; superlatives none (closest L6 'much more valuable' is a verbatim Bland quote, not a self-grade); number+retraction none; closest L4 three-item series 'want it / should do it / can build it' has concrete legs; verb triplet none.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body grep banned/dialect terms clean; closest L4 'assumptions' and 'map' are ordinary product vocabulary; no maintainer-dialect (surface/firing/beat/compendium) in L1-8.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -c '\*\*' on body L1-8 -> 0; no bold at all, within budget.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: single transparent slide file included via module deck; section is a top-level ## slide, no phase-less prose section

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-numbering.js --file curriculum/slides/riskiest-assumption-first.md -> OK, exit 0; no hand-numbered header.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js --file ... -> 'OK — 1 files, no page-geometry pointers', exit 0; grep below/above in body -> 0.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no in-body links (has_urls false; no [..](..) in body)

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file ... -> oversized: 0, 1 slide within 210 words / 6 bullets (body ~119 words, 3 paragraphs); exit 0.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L1 '## Test first what matters most and is proven least' is a claim-shaped imperative suiting a lecture slide; the file is a lecture slide, not an exercise.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L8 'An agent can draft the list... Where each one sits on the map is the team's call' adds a move (agent drafts) and an owner (team places) not held elsewhere; L6 quote is the sourced point, not a restatement of the header; no doctrine restatement, design commentary or kicker.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no header-rename provenance in maintainer note; slide created 2026-10-07 under its current header

notes: Single-slide file; no ## beyond the first. Accept-notes: none authorising rule exceptions (maintainer block holds STATUS and Fidelity guard only; dated lines are status/source stamps).
